about: The offertorium of the formulary “Second Sunday after Epiphany” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Sing joyfully unto God, all the earth; sing a psalm to His name; come and hear, all ye who fear God, and I will tell you what great things the Lord hath done for my soul. Alleluia.
g: tell, tell about, relate, narrate, recount, describe
